title: Welcome
subtitle: How Viewscape One works — and a tour of every block.
description: This page is both the manual and the demo. Everything below is rendered from a single `page.json`.
author: me

blocks.title: Drop a folder. **Get a hologram.**
blocks.subtitle: Each page is a folder with a `page.json`. The framework renders it, wraps it in a holographic box on the home field, and gives it the radial wheel.

blocks.text: Write the **data**, not the page. Viewscape handles layout, motion, media and navigation.

paragraphs: Multiple paragraphs are native: pass `paragraphs` as an array, or write one `text` string with blank lines, **bold**, *italic*, ==highlights==, `code` and [links](https://example.com).
Link to another page with `[[ai/sample-intel|that page]]` — it opens inside the hologram box without leaving the field.
Link to a file relative to this folder, like [the data file](data/extras.json), and it just works on GitHub Pages.

blocks.title: Look right →
blocks.text: The glowing orb on the right edge is the wheel. **Hold it, drag toward a wedge, release.** Or tap it, then tap a wedge. Press **W** on a keyboard. Wedges with a dot open a sub-wheel.
Add up to 8 per page in `wheel.extras`. Each has a `label`, `icon`, `hint` and an `action`:

items.title: Ask AI for a page
items.text: Paste `HANDOVER.json` into AI, describe the topic.

items.title: Import
items.text: Studio → paste the bundle → download the zip, or `node tools/vs.mjs import`.

items.title: Where do images and videos go?

blocks.text: Put them next to `page.json` (e.g. `media/clip.mp4`) and reference `media/clip.mp4`. Paths are relative to the page folder so they work on any GitHub Pages path.

items.title: Can a page be fully custom?

blocks.text: Yes — set `"type": "custom"` and write your own `index.html`, `page.css`, `page.js`. See [[me/custom-lab|Custom Lab]].
Any sufficiently advanced interface is indistinguishable from a hologram.
